performance.full_table_scans: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS database_name, DIGEST_TEXT AS query_pattern, COUNT_STAR AS total_executions, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000000, 2) AS total_latency_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS avg_latency_ms, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS full_table_scans, SUM_NO_GOOD_INDEX_USED AS bad_index_scans, ROUND((SUM_NO_INDEX_USED / COUNT_STAR) * 100, 2) AS full_scan_pct, FIRST_SEEN, LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE LAST_SEEN >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_NO_INDEX_USED DESC, SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 15;
performance.temporary_table_usage: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS database_name, DIGEST_TEXT AS query_pattern, COUNT_STAR AS total_executions, SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES AS total_tmp_tables, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES AS total_tmp_disk_tables, ROUND((SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES / NULLIF(SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES, 0)) * 100, 2) AS disk_tmp_pct, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS avg_latency_ms, LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE LAST_SEEN >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES > 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES DESC, SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES DESC LIMIT 15;
performance.lock_wait_statistics: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA AS database_name, OBJECT_NAME AS table_name, COUNT_STAR AS total_lock_waits, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS total_wait_time_ms, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS avg_wait_time_ms, ROUND(MAX_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS max_wait_time_ms FROM performance_schema.table_lock_waits_summary_by_table WHERE SUM_TIMER_WAIT > 0 AND OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 15;

indexes.unused_indexes: SELECT u.object_schema AS database_name, u.object_name AS table_name, u.index_name, ROUND((stat.stat_value * @@innodb_page_size) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_size_mb FROM sys.schema_unused_indexes u JOIN mysql.innodb_index_stats stat ON u.object_schema = stat.database_name AND u.object_name = stat.table_name AND u.index_name = stat.index_name WHERE stat.stat_name = 'size' AND u.object_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY index_size_mb DESC;

innodb.buffer_pool_hit_ratio: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests') AS total_read_requests, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') AS disk_reads, ROUND((1 - ((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'))) * 100, 2) AS buffer_pool_hit_ratio_pct;
innodb.dirty_pages_count_and_ratio: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty') AS dirty_pages_count, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total') AS total_pages_count, ROUND((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total') * 100, 2) AS dirty_page_pct;
innodb.redo_log_stats: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_waits') AS log_buffer_waits, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_write_requests') AS write_requests, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_writes') AS physical_writes, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_os_log_fsyncs') AS total_fsyncs;

connection_and_threads.connections_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Max_used_connections') AS max_concurrent_connections_recorded, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'max_connections') AS configured_max_connections, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Max_used_connections') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'max_connections')) * 100, 2) AS max_connection_utilization_pct;
connection_and_threads.thread_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_cached') AS cached_threads, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_created') AS total_threads_created, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_created') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS thread_miss_ratio_pct;
connection_and_threads.aborted_connections_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_connects') AS total_aborted_connects_auth, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_clients') AS total_aborted_clients_network, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections') AS total_connection_attempts, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_connects') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS abort_auth_pct, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_clients') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS abort_client_pct;

storage_and_system.table_fragmentation_status: SELECT table_schema AS database_name, table_name, ROUND(data_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS data_size_mb, ROUND(index_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_size_mb, ROUND(data_free / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS fragmented_free_space_mb, ROUND((data_free / NULLIF(data_length + index_length + data_free, 0)) * 100, 2) AS fragmentation_pct FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND data_free > 0 ORDER BY fragmented_free_space_mb DESC LIMIT 15;
